1.consolidated_definition: Comprar comida en un restaurante para comer en otro sitio. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Sistema de órdenes por internet, para take-out o para delivery propio del restaurante. Tecnología avanzada, funcionalidades modernas y beneficios directos (foodnet,pr, consultado 19-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To purchase food at a restaurant for consumption elsewhere. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Internet ordering system, specifically designed for take-out or delivery by the restaurant itself. Advanced technology, modern functionalities, and direct benefits (foodnet, pr, consulted 19-10-08)
